title: Physicochemical properties of tire-derived para-phenylenediamine quinones – a comparison of experimental and computational approaches
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2550-2563
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00153F, Paper
Simon H. Maguire, Misha Zvekic, Angelina Jaeger, Joseph Monaghan, Erik T. Krogh, Heather A. Wiebe
We report experimental water solubilities and test the accuracy of predictive models for 6PPDQ and its analogs, aiding in risk assessment and the search for safer tire additives through improved fate and distribution models.
